raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Victoria from Latin victoria, victor (conqueror) + -ia (abstract noun suffix); victor from vincere (to conquer)",
    "reading": "The state or act of conquering; abstract victory as a feminine noun",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "Lewis & Short, A Latin Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.95
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Vic + toria; vic (Latin vicis = change, turn) + toria (tor + ia; tor = tower, ia = land)",
    "reading": "Turning tower of the land; a pivot or axis of transformation",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.55
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Victoria → vik + toria; vik (Old Norse vík = bay, inlet) + toria (Greek toria = piercing, boring)",
    "reading": "The bay that pierces; a coastal wound that becomes a passage",
    "languages": ["non", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Victoria → V + I + C + T + O + R + I + A; rearranged: 'Civita' (Italian city) + 'or' (gold) + 'I' (ego)",
    "reading": "The golden city of the self; civic triumph as inner alchemy",
    "languages": ["it", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.35
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "V.I.C.T.O.R.I.A. → Virgo, Ignis, Crux, Terra, Orbis, Ratio, Ignis, Aurora",
    "reading": "Virgin, fire, cross, earth, world, reason, fire, dawn — a solar initiatic sequence",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "V (victory sign, horns) + I (eye) + C (crescent) + T (tau cross) + O (circle) + R (river) + I (eye) + A (alpha)",
    "reading": "Horned eye, crescent cross, circle river, eye alpha — a glyph of cosmic victory",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.45
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "V=5, I=1, C=100, T=200 (Greek tau), O=70 (Greek omicron), R=80 (Greek rho), I=1, A=1 → sum 458; 4+5+8=17; 1+7=8",
    "reading": "Reduces to 8, the number of renewal and resurrection; victory as cyclic rebirth",
    "languages": ["la", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Victoria → from vīc- (perfect stem of vincere) + -toria (suffix of agency); related to vindex (defender, avenger)",
    "reading": "The avenger's outcome; victory as vindication of the wronged",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "de Vaan, Etymological Dictionary of Latin",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Vic + toria; vic (English 'vicar' from vicarius = substitute) + toria (Latin 'torus' = bulge, knot)",
    "reading": "Substitute's knot; victory as a stand-in for a deeper, unspoken force",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Victoria → 'victor' (Latin) + 'ria' (Spanish 'ría' = estuary); also 'victor' (French) + 'ia' (Greek 'ia' = healing)",
    "reading": "Conqueror's estuary — a healing flow where victory meets the sea",
    "languages": ["la", "es", "fr", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Victoria → 'Vita' (life) + 'cor' (heart) + 'ia' (land); also 'Civita' + 'ro' (wheel)",
    "reading": "Life-heart-land; the wheel of the civic heart turning toward victory",
    "languages": ["la", "it"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.35
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "V (valley) + I (pillar) + C (cup) + T (tree) + O (sun) + R (road) + I (pillar) + A (beginning)",
    "reading": "Valley, pillar, cup, tree, sun, road, pillar, beginning — a path of ascent",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.25
  }
]
